title: Make some more functions static that are not referred to
description:
Note that these are/were included in header files, but
certainly no in-tree users refer to them.

There are many more - some functions do have comments to
suggest they are in fact being used by someone.

I'm not sure why in my build it doesn't complain about packet-reload.h now being deleted.  Also, had not noticed that in the log it hide/fold entire commands/sections!  Hopefully fixed now.

I will probably do some more cleanups like this.  Mostly they are where I guess people unthinkingly add declarations into a header file just in case someone ever needs it, or maybe just as effectively forward declaring things that can then appear in the C file in any order.

But there is always a chance that someone is actually calling it out of tree - it would be good to find and add comments to these. Unfortunately the only strategy might be to break it, and let them come to me :)
Sounds good with some cleanup, I might have some more undocumented usage.. lets see what you find :)

I am running ./tools/check_static.py

If you wanted to run it (it won't work with MSVC), you would need to make sure your build is up to date, then probably specify --build-folder when you run it
Got it! Found a couple already, will try to fix it ASAP :)
